description: This file defines the GatekeeperChannel interface for handling synchronous communication over IPC/RPC related to the Gatekeeper service. It includes method declarations for sending requests and responses and receiving messages, acting as an abstraction layer over transport channels.

classes.name: GatekeeperChannel
classes.description: An interface class that enables communication with the Gatekeeper service via IPC/RPC, providing methods for sending requests and responses, and receiving messages.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a command identifier and the GateKeeperMessage payload.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a command identifier and the GateKeeperMessage payload.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the transport layer, returning a ManagedMessage object.
